newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks end lower on strike threat.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks end lower on strike threat.

text.p: Dhaka stocks ended lower as investors reacted adversely to an opposition threat to stage strikes on Thursday to protest the new budget, brokers said.
The 1997/98 budget is due to be passed by the parliament late on Monday and be effective from Tuesday.

The Dhaka Stock Exchange all share price index lost 16.94 points or 1.50 percent at 1,111.55 on a turnover of 56.1 million taka. Of 106 traded issues, 138 lost and 28 gained. "The market was in the grip of budget scepticism. Strike threat further dampened the sentiment," said one broker. Bangladesh Lamps lost 48.95 taka to 4,970.49 and Apex Foods shed 116.72 to 2,074.61.
